architectureInvariants: Production macOS secret access targets the Data Protection Keychain through a signed Security.framework KeyProvider adapter, not security CLI arguments or a legacy custom file-backed keychain.
Keychain stores secret bytes but does not own CredentialGeneration or compare-and-swap semantics.
Provider Access owns durable credential generation, refresh fencing, and CAS metadata.
Agent Runtime file-backed keychains and retained backups require explicit 0600 enforcement and attestation.
Access-control mutation is a separately qualified operation from unattended secret rotation.
A retained backup can preserve an older secret generation, so crypto-erasure and backup invalidation are separate processes.
